question: The linked-repo half of the done-when criterion cannot be exercised live here: this repository carries no .sapience/project.json, and creating a real binding is a permanent, undeletable write to your hosted vault. Verify against a fixture binding, or bind a real repository first?
answer: Fixture-based verification — a scratch repo with a .sapience/project.json fixture and a stubbed GET /v1/people/projects, reusing the harness test-sapience-publish.sh already has; nothing reaches the live vault
obligation: Demonstrate that an orchestrated run in a repo carrying .sapience/project.json emits a KO body containing a resolved "project": "<key>" field and no project_cid key, while the same run in an unlinked repo emits a byte-identical body to today's.
